title: Naked truth magazine - issue 04
summary: Naked Truth Magazine issue 4 is a text-based e-zine from the mid-1990s warez and pirate software scene, edited by MindBender and Raptor after a merger with the Inquisition group. Written in informal, abbreviated English, it is a mix of editorials, group news, interviews and miscellany. Its main pieces include a long account by Clubber of the Enigma FTP site explaining why it dropped the release group Razor 1911 for Hybrid; a comic, allegorical story by Aslan about rival courier groups RiSK, MOLICE and MTS; and an interview with Darwin of RTS, who discusses the state of net versus BBS trading. Other items include an interview with the Rest in Peace BBS sysop Hula, a reader popularity poll naming the coolest people in the scene, and closing notes with contact and FTP details. The issue also reprints an earlier MindBender autumn edition. It is a snapshot of scene gossip, rivalries and cultural attitudes of the period rather than a conventional literary work.
